title: Console HTML document
responsibility: Builds a complete console document with inline viewer assets and host settings while leaving history and media to protected endpoints.

inputs.name: consoleDocument.assets
inputs.description: Compiled JavaScript and CSS text to inline in the HTML document.

inputs.name: consoleDocument.options
inputs.description: Console base path with optional title, export availability and navigation links. Title defaults to Harness and exportable defaults to false.

outputs.name: consoleDocument
outputs.description: Complete HTML string with escaped title, serialized settings and inline assets protected against closing their elements. It contains the viewer shell, not history data, and does not enforce access policy itself.
